name: [👮] Tactical: Swat Simulator
desc:
🚨 SWAT Simulator
Play as an elite SWAT officer in a realistic police simulator focused on high-risk operations and tactical missions. Respond to dangerous situations like bank robberies, prison riots, house raids, and port takeovers. Breach buildings, clear rooms, and take down suspects in a well-paced SWAT experience.

👮 How To Play:
- Join the game and select your gear and weapons from the locker.
- Walk up to a mission pad to start an operation.
- Complete objectives, clear the area, and stop hostile suspects.

⭐ Expect new updates every week!

🎉 Join our group and like the game to unlock $350 + 100XP.
